kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نقترع (form VIII)
# نَقْتَرِعُ (naqtariʕu) /naq.ta.ri.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# نُقْتَرَعُ (nuqtaraʕu) /nuq.ta.ra.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# نَقْتَرِعَ (naqtariʕa) /naq.ta.ri.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# نُقْتَرَعَ (nuqtaraʕa) /nuq.ta.ra.ʕa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
